annotations.text:
PropSights rework — first layouts.
Left column: style tile → landing (desktop + mobile). Right column: Playground → map states.
Open question in the style tile: terracotta (A) or mustard (B) as the accent? Everything else uses A for now.
Type v2: Sora (display) · Manrope (body) · JetBrains Mono (labels) — rounded, techy.

Hero v4: REAL data — all 14,494 active listings plotted (positions + effective occupancy from the serving DB), real coastline, districts, municipalities and OSM roads. Stats strip below the map uses real numbers for the drawn Protaras polygon (queried 2026-08-30). Map zooms in place (clipped, soft edge) 3.3×, focus beat on Protaras · Pernera before drawing; cursor clicks 5 vertices; stats sit clear below. Three acts, plays once (38s): draw Protaras → glide west, draw Coral Bay → zoom out to both areas + side-by-side comparison (all real numbers, queried 2026-08-30). Holds on the comparison with a Replay chip. Kicker sentence removed (one headline only — Z-pattern); a small mono status line inside the map narrates the steps instead. Hero shows 3 KPIs (occupancy, rate, yield) + occupancy graph per area; full stats live in the Playground card below. BUILD NOTE: start the sequence only when the hero is in view and ~1s after the headline renders; play once; pause if scrolled away.

Headline alternates (same sub-copy works with each):
A · The whole Cyprus property market, down to the street.  ← in the mockup
B · Every rental and every sale in Cyprus, on one map.
C · Cyprus property, street by street: rent, let, or sell.
Map control borrows the idea (not the look) from Bazaraki: one “Where?” field with search / draw / radius / locate, explicit Cancel–Apply, selection in the URL.
